decisions.reason: It sits close to the core business, has been publicly maintained on its own page for two years, and management can justify continued support given long space-market qualification cycles.
The product has strong public commitment and visible mission validation through the ESA HERA launch, making withdrawal very unlikely.
As an extension of the firm’s established sensing capabilities with two years of dedicated website presence, it fits the announced strategic direction and invites continued commitment.
Its weaker website presence makes it somewhat more vulnerable, but miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR matches the firm’s future-oriented roadmap so management is still likely to persist.
Although newly launched, it is close to the firm’s proven camera business and has already received a dedicated product page, supporting continued backing rather than an early exit.
